locator.label: 合成材料 · 第 1 段

blocks.en: Redundant execution can detect transient faults, but duplicating every operation consumes limited resources. We define selective replication as duplicating only operations designated by a configurable policy. We argue that selective replication can improve fault detection within a fixed resource budget. A synthetic background reference is provided in [1].
blocks.zh: 冗余执行能够检测瞬态故障，但复制所有操作会消耗有限的资源。本文将选择性复制定义为：仅对可配置策略指定的操作进行复制。我们的核心主张是，在资源预算固定的条件下，选择性复制能够改善故障检测效果。合成的背景文献见 [1]。

locator.label: 合成材料 · 第 2 段

blocks.en: We compared a selective policy with uniform replication using the same replication budget on three synthetic workloads. Across 300 injected transient faults per policy, the selective policy detected 264 faults, whereas uniform replication detected 231. These results support a detection benefit under the tested conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们在三种合成工作负载上，以相同的复制预算比较选择性策略与均匀复制策略。对每种策略均注入 300 次瞬态故障，选择性策略检测到其中 264 次，均匀复制策略检测到 231 次。这些结果支持选择性策略在所测试条件下具有检测优势。

the selective policy detected 264 faults, whereas uniform replication detected 231

locator.label: 合成材料 · 第 3 段

blocks.en: Although the selective policy improved detection in this experiment, the workloads were synthetic and permanent faults were not tested. We therefore limit our conclusion to transient faults under the evaluated workloads. Further evaluation is needed before extending the claim to deployed systems.
blocks.zh: 尽管选择性策略在本次实验中提高了检测效果，但所用工作负载均为合成负载，且实验未覆盖永久性故障。因此，我们将结论限定于所评估工作负载下的瞬态故障。在把这一主张推广到实际部署系统之前，仍需进一步评估。
